content.text: Digital creators in regions where payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are restricted face significant challenges in setting up their online stores. This guide addresses how to leverage [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-complete-infrastructure-12|supabase]] as your order database to facilitate [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|Crypto Payment]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-2|COREMERCH guide to payments]] without relying on traditional payment gateways. By using COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can deploy a fully operational digital store that embodies sovereignty and control over your commerce operations. Whether you're in Nigeria, Kenya, or another area facing access issues, this guide provides a clear pathway to establishing your digital storefront using Stack 01 or Stack 02.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The reliance on centralized payment platforms has left many creators vulnerable to restrictions and access issues. By adopting a decentralized approach with COREMERCH, you bypass these limitations entirely. Stack 01, utilizing GitHub Pages and Apps Script, offers a streamlined deployment method that can be executed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. This setup ensures that you maintain full ownership of your data and transactions, granting you independence from external platforms that often impose fees and restrictions. The architecture empowers you to operate freely in a landscape that may otherwise inhibit your commercial activities.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, ensure you have the necessary tools and accounts set up. You’ll need a GitHub account to host your site on GitHub Pages and a Google account for Apps Script. Furthermore, sign up for NOWPayments to manage your crypto transactions efficiently. Familiarize yourself with Supabase if you opt for Stack 02, as it serves as the order database and simplifies data management. Gather your digital products, create the necessary documentation, and prepare your promotional strategy. This groundwork will enable a seamless deployment process once you start.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish a robust payment and delivery pipeline, begin by setting up your order database using Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your stack choice. For Stack 01, configure Apps Script to handle order processing and integrate it with NOWPayments for real-time crypto payment verification. Ensure that your order processing logic is tested on the mainnet to avoid issues during customer transactions. Once payments are verified, automate delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation. This seamless integration streamlines your operations and enhances the customer experience.
Empower your commerce with infrastructure that guarantees ownership and control.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your GitHub Pages site or Cloudflare Pages, depending on your chosen stack. Promote your store through social media and existing networks to drive initial traffic. Monitor your site for any unexpected issues or customer inquiries. When processing your first transaction, ensure that your backend logic functions as intended by performing a test purchase. Confirm that the payment is processed through NOWPayments, and that the delivery mechanism works flawlessly. This initial transaction will validate your setup and provide insights into potential enhancements.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Evaluate your Supabase database performance and adjust as necessary to handle increased traffic. With Stack 02, you can easily add more products and enhance your store's capabilities. Optimize your marketing efforts to attract a larger audience. Consider implementing additional features such as email marketing through SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration to ensure high deliverability. Continuous monitoring and refining of your infrastructure will allow you to grow sustainably while maintaining full control of your digital commerce.

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by utilizing COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01 can be deployed in 4-6 hours with GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02, which includes Supabase, is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Both stacks allow you to maintain full control over your data and payment processing.
Deploy your digital store without the limitations of traditional payment platforms.

Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account for hosting your site. Set up a Google account to use Apps Script for your backend. Register for NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Prepare your digital products and documentation. Configure your order database via Supabase or Google Sheets. Test your payment and delivery systems before going live. Promote your store to attract customers and monitor transactions closely.
